dict.Ascult sunetul clipului ca să găsesc pau: Listening to the clip sound to find the pauses…
dict.Clipul pare să fie numai liniște, așa că: The clip seems to be all silence, so nothing was removed.
dict.Doar pauzele cel puțin atât de lungi se: Only pauses at least this long are removed
dict.Găsește în sunetul clipului liniștea (pa: Finds the silence in the clip sound (the pauses between sentences, the waiting at the start and at the end) and removes it; the clip stays in joined pieces, which can be shortened or moved. Ctrl+Z puts them back.
dict.Nu am putut citi sunetul clipului (poate: Could not read the clip sound (maybe it has no sound or it is too large).
dict.Pauzele se scot doar din clipurile salva: Pauses can only be removed from clips saved on the computer, in the installed app.

templates.Am scos liniștea de la capetele clipului: Removed the silence at the ends of clip {0} ({1} s).
templates.Am scos pauzele din clipul {0} ({1} s):: Removed the pauses from clip {0} ({1} s): it is now in {2} pieces.
templates.Nu am găsit pauze mai lungi de {0} s în: No pauses longer than {0} s were found in clip {1}.
